normalized_facts: Google posted an investigation for reported Mandiant Managed Defense ingestion issues involving some CrowdStrike Falcon integrations.
The final engineering investigation concluded that there was no service degradation during the reported period.
The final update also states that no supported CrowdStrike alerts were missed during the period.
EvalForge treats this only as a candidate real-world negative-control family: an operationally visible suspected incident whose supported system scope was ultimately found healthy.
provenance_limitations: This file is an EvalForge normalized semantic snapshot of the official Google Cloud Service Health entry, not a byte-for-byte copy of the page.
The no_fault mapping is limited to the final supported-service scope described by the source and remains non-admitted pending the Phase 03 control-family policy and original-source preservation gate.
